# HAPI v0.30.7.2 (maintained build)

Maintenance bugfix release for official GitHub Release `v0.30.7` and maintained build `v0.30.7.1`.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

Compared with `v0.30.7.1`:

- Fix fatal scroll re-render crash in Web UI: resolve "Maximum update depth exceeded. The result of getSnapshot should be cached to avoid an infinite loop". In `@assistant-ui/core`, `ThreadListRuntimeImpl.subscribe` now correctly subscribes to `stateBinding` instead of leaking a raw disconnected core subscription, and `LazyMemoizeSubject.getState` now guarantees referential stability across unmemoized snapshot calls with shallow equality comparisons.
- Keep all existing features from `v0.30.7.1`, including PR `#1436` voice dictation direct-send, cross-session message delivery, `#1771` native session-runtime, and fleet upgrades.

## Compared with the official release

Compared with official `v0.30.7`, includes the maintained desktop, fleet upgrades, imports, model-error handling, scratchlist, schema V29, protocol V2 overlay, session-roots guard, voice dictation direct-send, scroll snapshot memoization fix, and the audited changes above.

## Personal PR policy exceptions

`#1436` is carried as personal author auto-carry, restoring the voice direct-send button and cross-session delivery. `#1771` is kept as the native session-runtime skill. `#1635` and `#1419` are carried.

## Distribution

Standalone four-part maintenance release, with signed macOS CLI archives, Linux and Windows CLI archives, Windows/macOS desktop bundles, and `checksums.txt`. Optional platform packages remain on official `0.30.7`. The implicit standalone upgrade channel remains off.
